game_title: Flowchart Lab · Sum from 1 to n
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge, a forge fed by magma: the ash ranger must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of ember crystals is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge: a forge fed by magma
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Add all whole numbers from 1 through n, then display the total. For n = 0, display 0. Test dataset 4: {'n': 0}; {'n': 9}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Magma Forge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 340 points of ember crystals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
